amendment_basis: URL-only development validation showed inadequate recall before any Hannousse test scoring. This separate branch evaluates archived page features; it is a within-corpus new-domain experiment, not unseen-source transfer.
features: 44 recomputed normalized_url_v3 statistics plus 24 published content features. Exclude all released reputation, WHOIS, DNS, traffic, page-rank, Google-index and blacklist features.
initial_pool: Hannousse fold 3, split by registered domain: 70% fitting, 30% calibration with seed 20261007
replay_pool: Hannousse fold 4, never part of initial fitting or calibration
test_pool: Hannousse folds 0-2, never part of fitting, calibration, replay or model selection
selection_rule: Highest mean calibration recall at 5% legitimate-row FPR across seeds; tie by AP, then listed family order. Cutoff ties excluded together. No test scores for selection.
weighting: Equal class mass and equal domain contribution within class
path_profile: Sort domains by average URL path length, randomly break ties using the replay seed; domain records stay adjacent. This is a constructed covariate profile, not a claim of natural temporal drift.
stationary: Shuffle the identical fold-4 records with the replay seed
feedback_contract: Predict first. Labels arrive only after prediction at batch t+delay. Store decision version; after any estimator/cutoff update reset ADWIN and ignore old-version errors for its state. Retain all original predictions for scoring.
update_contract: At each allowed update combine initial anchors with revealed recent labels, split domains for refit/calibration deterministically, require both classes in each part. Threshold policy keeps the original estimator; periodic refits every four arrivals; drift refits on ADWIN alarm after cooldown.
final_assessment: Score every saved final checkpoint on sealed domains only after selection and all replays are frozen. Report all policies, delays, orders and seeds, with paired domain bootstrap for seed 42.
scope: Binary classification of archived records using creator-supplied webpage measurements. No current website content fetched or independently relabelled. Published measurements are not independently re-extracted from HTML.
correction_after_test_inspection: Threshold-only calibration now uses original calibration plus revealed recent replay domains, excluding every domain used by its retained initial estimator. No estimator/hyperparameter/cutoff selection based on test. Corrected threshold tests are post-inspection verification, not new blind evidence.
